name: Do I need to hire a plumber for sink disconnection/reconnection during installation?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to hire a plumber for sink disconnection/reconnection during installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Typically, you will need to arrange for a plumber to disconnect your existing sink and reconnect the new or existing sink after the granite countertops are installed. Our installation team focuses specifically on the countertop fabrication and installation. While we can remove the old countertops and set the new sink into place, we do not handle plumbing work. This preparation step ensures that your water connections are handled by a licensed professional, preventing potential leaks or issues after our work is complete.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, you generally need to hire a plumber to disconnect and reconnect sinks, as our countertop installation service does not include plumbing work. This ensures proper water connections.
